narr: A slow moving front and persistent deep moisture across the southern Midlands helped produce isolated flash flooding from scattered thunderstorms, primarily in Barnwell County.
ev: Emergency Manager reported flash flooding throughout the city of Barnwell. EM observed 4.8 inches of rain at their home and stated that many city streets flooded as storm drains could not handle that amount. Time estimated by EM.
